questions: features/requests.feature, the requests#r17 scenario 'turn passing a request to its asker with a line that has <line 2> sets the request's status to awaiting-asker', is a Scenario Outline with no Examples table, so its Given reaches the step as the literal text '<line 2>'. The implementer may not change features/, and the plan cannot pick the cases. Which line-2 cases does it pin? Reading A: the formulation adds an Examples table with two rows, line 2 with no line outcome and line 2 with the line outcome question. The narrator runs `work turn q1` twice and sees status awaiting-asker both times. Reading B: the formulation makes it a plain Scenario naming one case (e.g. line 2 with the line outcome question). The narrator sees awaiting-asker for that one case only. Reading C: no spec change. The step reads the literal '<line 2>' as a line with no line outcome. The narrator sees awaiting-asker, but the scenario's title and step stay literal, and the case of an outcome other than accepted, refused or withdrawn is never pinned.
